facts.statement: Caching is an exact prefix match; a change anywhere in the prefix recomputes everything after it.
Requests are layered system prompt, then project context, then conversation, so a conversation change leaves the two above it cached.
Cache writes bill at 1.25x base input for the 5 minute TTL and 2x for the 1 hour TTL; reads at 0.1x.
On a Claude subscription the 1 hour TTL is requested automatically; an API key stays at 5 minutes; subagents use 5 minutes either way.
A subscription over its plan limit, drawing on usage credits, drops back to the 5 minute TTL.
Both model and effort level are part of the cache key; changing effort mid-session rebuilds the whole prefix.
Editing a root or user CLAUDE.md mid-session does not invalidate the cache and does not apply until reload.
Nested CLAUDE.md and rules with `paths:` frontmatter load later and an edit before they load does take effect.
Editing MCP config does not itself change the cache; it applies on restart.
Enabling or disabling a plugin that ships only skills, commands, agents or hooks is cache-safe; only one providing an MCP server invalidates.
MCP tool definitions are deferred behind tool search by default on supported models; deferral is unavailable in named cases.
A whole-tool deny rule invalidates the cache.
`/rewind` returns to an already-cached prefix; `/recap` appends without replacing history.
A warm mid-session `/compact` costs a fraction of what the context size suggests.
The cache is scoped per machine and per working directory; two worktrees of one repo miss each other's cache.
The auto-memory index loads the first 200 lines or 25KB, whichever comes first; content past that is dropped.
CLAUDE.md targets under 200 lines and loads in full regardless of length.
Block-level HTML comments are stripped before the index is loaded; `@path` imports expand at launch.
`disable-model-invocation: true` stops a skill loading until invoked; `skillOverrides` has four states and does not affect plugin skills.
A SessionEnd hook event exists and its input includes the transcript path.
An `InstructionsLoaded` hook event fires at session start and when instruction files load lazily.
`includeGitInstructions: false` removes the built-in commit and PR workflow instructions.
`claudeMdExcludes` skips named CLAUDE.md files when loading memory.
`skillOverrides` can hide or collapse a skill per name.
`MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS` caps MCP tool output size.
Tool search is on by default and `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` controls it.
`/btw` asks a question without adding to conversation history.
Agent frontmatter supports `model`, `effort`, and `maxTurns`.
